title: SkillSight: Calibrating Generic Content Bias for Skill Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2607.18785v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As large language model agents gain access to increasingly large skill libraries, retrieving the right skill becomes critical to reliable capability selection and execution. Existing retrievers often treat skill contents as ordinary documents, overlooking their highly regular structure: shared descriptive patterns recur across many skills while providing little evidence for distinguishing the required capability. We show that this shared descriptive background is reflected in dense relevance scores, induces a pronounced energy gap between queries and skill documents, and obscures discriminative signals, especially for structurally similar hard negatives. Based on this observation, we propose SkillSight, a training-free retrieval framework that calibrates shared background in both semantic and lexical spaces. translated_title: 技能视界：校准通用内容偏差以提升技能检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.18785v3 公告类型：替换  摘要：随着大语言模型智能体能够访问日益庞大的技能库，检索正确的技能对于可靠的能力选择和执行变得至关重要。现有的检索器通常将技能内容视为普通文档，忽视了其高度规律的结构：共享的描述模式在众多技能中反复出现，却几乎无法提供区分所需能力的证据。我们表明，这种共享的描述背景反映在稠密相关性分数中，导致查询与技能文档之间存在显著的能量差距，并掩盖了判别性信号，尤其对于结构相似的困难负样本。基于这一观察，我们提出了SkillSight，一种无需训练的检索框架，在语义和词汇空间中校准共享背景。语义背景校准通过IDF识别的通用标记估计背景子空间，从而降低相似性归纳。
tldr: 本文提出SkillSight，一种无需训练的检索框架，通过校准技能内容中共享的通用背景偏差（分别在语义和词汇空间），显著提升大语言模型智能体在技能库中的检索准确性，尤其在面对结构相似的困难负样本时。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SkillSight, a training-free retrieval framework that calibrates shared generic background bias in both semantic and lexical spaces, significantly improving skill retrieval accuracy for large language model agents, especially on structurally similar hard negatives.
